definition.opening: first 15 offensive snaps, indexed before WP filtering
definition.pace: clock seconds between adjacent neutral snaps in the same drive and quarter; gaps 1–60 seconds
definition.use: public proxies; bounded pressure sensitivity, not causal or calibrated win-rate estimates
definition.pass_snap_proxy: player pass snaps / team dropbacks with offense_players charting; targets use the same charted snaps
definition.route_expansion_flag: at least 50 pass snaps, targets/pass snap >=25%, participation <70%; heuristic flag

availability.routes: proxy: pass snaps on charted dropbacks; not routes run
availability.trench: proxy: charted pressure rates; not PRWR/PBWR
availability.play_caller: inactive: verified OC assignment history unavailable
availability.coverage_adjustment: inactive: historical splits exported; matchup calibration pending
availability.period_probability: baseline: scaled moments and early pace
